# The original request

> **What:** the request for Campaign Planner exactly as the person gave it, kept word for word
> **Read when:** checking that the plan still covers what was asked (every demand is listed in coverage.md)

Paste the request below once, word for word, and never edit it. A new or changed request is a new section with its date, added below.

## Request

Build a campaign planner for our agency.

- Planners create a campaign for a client with a name, dates and channels.
- Planners see all campaigns of a client, newest first.
- A calendar shows every scheduled post; planners drag posts between days.
- Clients approve posts through a link.
- Later: reach per campaign. No AI features yet.

It should feel calm, like a paper planner, in the agency brand.
